findings: October 5 adds a Managed Payments-specific Pay Invoice route to finalize and attempt payment on a Managed Payments Invoice using its already-associated payment method, excluding replacement methods and other payment-related request parameters (raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-changelog-2026-11-07.md:9-13 versus raw/stripe-managed-payments-changelog-2026.md:4-10). The generic Invoice Pay reference shows the invoice-ID endpoint and generic optional fields such as payment_method, source and paid_out_of_band (raw/stripe-api-invoices-pay-2026-11-07.md:5-24,124-150). Keep the more restrictive Managed Payments route reciprocal. Attempt does not establish payment, a paid state, funds availability, or new freedom to generate out-of-period one-off invoices (raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-changelog-2026-11-07.md:83-88).

September 3 adds payment_intent_data.setup_future_usage and payment_method_options.{payment_method}.setup_future_usage at Managed Payments Checkout Session creation (raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-changelog-2026-11-07.md:15-19). The prior one-time migration table explicitly excludes both (raw/stripe-managed-payments-update-checkout-2025.md:191-205; wiki/sources/source-stripe-managed-payments-update-checkout.md:52-61). Date and cross-link that conflict. The new migration introduction retains product eligibility, Dashboard activation, hosted/embedded Checkout modes, 2025-03-31.basil or later and no converting existing subscriptions (raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-update-checkout-2026-11-07.md:5-22). That general minimum is not the introduction version for September flags. The changelog does not establish supported values or methods, reuse outside Managed Payments or setup/payment success. Separate subscription authorization limitation remains in the dated mobile guide (raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-set-up-mobile-2026-11-07.md:515-517).

June 2 adds exactly four cited AIaaS product tax codes, txcd_10105001 through txcd_10105004, for cloud-only and cloud-plus-download, each split by personal/business use (raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-changelog-2026-11-07.md:21-30, raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-eligibility-2026-11-07.md:100-108,114-122). Eligible code is one requirement alongside direct sale, distribution rights and fully automated digital product in the separate eligibility guide (raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-eligibility-2026-11-07.md:91-102); no across-the-board AI product entitlement follows.

The Sigma item newly appears under the April 22 historical date, absent from April's capture (raw/stripe-managed-payments-changelog-2026.md:8-37, raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-changelog-2026-11-07.md:61-65; tracking/collections/stripe/recollection-2026-11-07-en/pages/5708c13fa6b4737b33a03186/content.diff:42-49). It describes managed_payments_enabled in payment_intents, setup_intents, checkout_session (singular as documented), and subscriptions Sigma tables. Preserve its placement and report as a Sigma field, without inferring Stripe REST response fields, availability entitlement or queries executed.

The November retrospective September 22, 2025 list no longer contains txcd_10701000 Website Advertising (raw/stripe-managed-payments-changelog-2026.md:105-113, raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-changelog-2026-11-07.md:133-140, tracking/collections/stripe/recollection-2026-11-07-en/pages/5708c13fa6b4737b33a03186/content.diff:83-90). The source lists 21 codes and Website Advertising at wiki/sources/source-stripe-managed-payments-changelog.md:43-48, which is appropriate only as dated April capture history. The April eligibility table includes that code (raw/stripe-managed-payments-eligibility-2025.md:163-170), and the November website-category rows start with Website Hosting 10701100 (raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-eligibility-2026-11-07.md:166-175), so qualify the still-broad eligibility summary wiki/sources/source-stripe-managed-payments-eligibility.md:73-76. The paired omission and absent November listing provide a documented-list difference without a live withdrawal or grandfathering date.

Independently of new entries, the source wiki/sources/source-stripe-managed-payments-changelog.md:21-22 omits April's Invoice Line Items, and 'previously only Sold through Link' reverses the PDF issuer timing. Both raws say the business name is now shown beside product details and invoices are now issued by Sold through Link (raw/stripe-managed-payments-changelog-2026.md:18-27, raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-changelog-2026-11-07.md:42-51). At wiki/sources/source-stripe-managed-payments-changelog.md:26-33 add February's payment_behavior when updating Managed Payments subscriptions and keep one-off/outside-billing-period restriction scope (raw/stripe-managed-payments-changelog-2026.md:55-60, raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-changelog-2026-11-07.md:83-88). The concept's Customer-object invoice item exclusion at wiki/concepts/stripe-managed-payments.md:79-86 needs precise separation from adding eligible Invoice Items/Invoice Line Items to an invoice for a Managed Payments subscription. Invoice item addition differs from creating an out-of-period invoice and from paying an existing invoice.

The changelog's dated mobile prose claims a route without sending the user to a browser outside the mobile app (raw/stripe-managed-payments-changelog-2026.md:74-91, raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-changelog-2026-11-07.md:102-119), but the linked captured mobile guide explicitly opens browser Checkout in Safari for eligible iOS external links (raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-set-up-mobile-2026-11-07.md:5-9,335-343). Retain both scoped statements and put reciprocal clarification on the mobile and changelog routes. origin_context=mobile_app identifies a mobile-oriented Checkout UI and does not establish native processing or App Store eligibility.

contributions.original_prompts:
New raw: `raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-changelog-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw: `raw/stripe-managed-payments-changelog-2026.md`. Current summaries: `wiki/sources/source-stripe-managed-payments-changelog.md`.

- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/managed-payments/changelog`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7 capture of https://docs.stripe.com/payments/managed-payments/changelog adds three later Managed Payments entries and an April-dated Sigma entry missing from the April 23 capture. The October 5 Pay Invoice endpoint can finalize and attempt payment on a Managed Payments Invoice with its already associated payment method. It excludes payment method overrides and other payment-related request parameters. An attempt leaves payment success and funds availability unverified (new raw lines 9-13). On September 3 the changelog allows payment_intent_data.setup_future_usage and payment_method_options.{payment_method}.setup_future_usage when creating a Managed Payments Checkout Session. The separate November migration guide requires Dashboard enablement, hosted or embedded Checkout in payment or subscription mode, eligible products with eligible tax codes, and API version 2025-03-31.basil or later. That is the migration guide's general minimum, and the September entry does not specify the fields' introduction version (new raw lines 15-19 and raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-update-checkout-2026-11-07.md:9-22). The June 2 AIaaS codes in source order are txcd_10105001 for cloud-based personal use, txcd_10105002 for cloud-based business use, txcd_10105003 for cloud-based and downloaded personal use, and txcd_10105004 for cloud-based and downloaded business use. The separate eligibility guide still requires direct sale, distribution rights and a fully automated digital product (new raw lines 21-30 and raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-eligibility-2026-11-07.md:91-102). The backfilled April 22 Sigma item records managed_payments_enabled on payment_intents, setup_intents, checkout_session and subscriptions (new raw lines 61-65). The mapped source-stripe-managed-payments-changelog.md preserves much of the earlier rollout timeline. Its lines 19-33 need the April distinction that eligible Invoice Items and Invoice Line Items can be added to invoices for Managed Payments subscriptions, and that invoices are now issued by Sold through Link while showing the business name and product details. It also omits February's payment_behavior support when updating Managed Payments subscriptions (old raw lines 18-27 and 55-60, new raw lines 42-51 and 83-88).
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/managed-payments/changelog, Invoice Pay, both future-usage request fields, four AIaaS codes and the newly captured April Sigma field are substantive additions (new raw lines 9-30 and 61-65). Keep managed_payments_enabled scoped to Sigma reporting for the four named tables. Website Advertising txcd_10701000 disappears from the September 2025 historical list (old raw lines 105-113 and new raw lines 133-140). Date the source-stripe-managed-payments-changelog.md 21-code count to its April capture and add the reciprocal eligibility warning. The separate November eligibility table no longer lists the code, and the collected pages provide no live withdrawal or grandfathering date. Screenshot hosting, italics and whitespace are presentational. The older one-time Checkout migration table excludes both payment_intent_data.setup_future_usage and payment_method_options.{payment_method}.setup_future_usage. September's dated entry permits those same fields at Managed Payments Checkout Session creation (new raw lines 15-19 and raw/stripe-managed-payments-update-checkout-2025.md:191-205). Cross-link that scope without extending it to reuse outside Managed Payments or assigning a release-specific API version. Scope the generic Invoice Pay API fields to their documented surface. For Managed Payments the October entry excludes overrides and other payment-related request parameters, and February still blocks generating a one-off invoice outside a Managed Payments subscription's billing period (new raw lines 9-13 and 83-88, old raw lines 55-60). The historical mobile changelog says payment can stay inside the app (old raw lines 74-91 and new raw lines 102-119). The linked November guide describes eligible iOS external links with server-created Checkout Sessions and a client that opens the Session URL in Safari (raw/stripe-payments-managed-payments-set-up-mobile-2026-11-07.md:5-9,335-343). Route the discrepancy reciprocally and limit origin_context=mobile_app to its mobile-oriented Checkout UI. Preserve the April 39-country GA and invoice rules, February features and 2025 history as dated claims. The captures leave current account access, payment success and settlement unverified.
